summary.headline: SaVida Health secures $412K in annual savings across five spend categories; $358K already locked in
summary.narrative: Treya Partners’ six-month strategic sourcing engagement with SaVida Health delivered $411,000+ in identified annual savings across five addressable categories. The EMR renegotiation with incumbent Athena is fully executed, capturing $358K in hard savings. A newly executed Provista GPO agreement is set to trim another $32K from office and medical supplies once roster validation is complete, while telecom consolidation and IT hardware sourcing are poised to add a further $22K. The program combines rate reductions, GPO leverage, and supplier consolidation to strengthen SaVida’s cost structure for 2025 and beyond.
